<style>
:root {
  /* Layout idea: a strategy-firm profile. White space, editorial serif headlines, hairline rules, one deep-navy band, a single green accent. */
  --navy: #071d2e;        /* headings, dark bands */
  --paper: #ffffff;       /* page */
  --mist: #f4f6f7;        /* alternate sections */
  --rule: #d9dee2;        /* hairlines */
  --muted: #5b6874;       /* secondary text */
  --accent: #0c7a5b;      /* sustainability green */
  --text: #1a2631;
  --band: #071d2e;
  --band-text: #f2f5f7;
  --band-muted: #9fb0bf;
  --band-rule: rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  --ph: #e8f3ef;
  --font-display: "Newsreader", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-body: "Instrument Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --navy: #eef2f5; --paper: #0a1117; --mist: #101a22; --rule: #24323d; --muted: #93a1ad;
    --accent: #3fbf94; --text: #dfe6ec; --band: #050c12; --band-text: #eef2f5; --band-muted: #93a4b3;
    --ph: #133229; color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --navy: #eef2f5; --paper: #0a1117; --mist: #101a22; --rule: #24323d; --muted: #93a1ad;
  --accent: #3fbf94; --text: #dfe6ec; --band: #050c12; --band-text: #eef2f5; --band-muted: #93a4b3;
  --ph: #133229; color-scheme: dark;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
a { color: inherit; }
a:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--navy); font-weight: 400; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5.4vw, 4.6rem); line-height: 1.04; font-weight: 300; }
h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 3rem); line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 300; }
h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.25; }
p { margin: 0; }
.wrap { width: min(1200px, 100% - 48px); margin-inline: auto; }
.eyebrow { font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.ph { background: var(--ph); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--accent); padding: 0 .2em; }
.arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform .2s ease; }
a:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

/* ---------- Nav ---------- */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
.nav .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 68px; gap: 24px; }
.brand { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.35rem; color: var(--navy); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.brand b { font-weight: 600; }
.nav ul { display: flex; gap: 32px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-size: .9rem; }
.nav ul a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted); }
.nav ul a:hover { color: var(--navy); }
.nav .cta-link { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy); padding-bottom: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero { padding: 88px 0 72px; }
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.45fr 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: end; }
.hero h1 { margin-top: 24px; }
.hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--accent); }
.byline { margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 32px; }
.byline .name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--navy); }
.byline .title { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; grid-column: 1; }
.byline .lede { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; color: var(--muted); max-width: 46ch; font-size: 1rem; }
.btn-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 28px; align-items: center; margin-top: 36px; }
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--navy); color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; padding: 16px 28px; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; }
.btn:hover { background: var(--accent); }
.text-link { font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--navy); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-bottom: 3px; }
.text-link:hover { border-color: var(--navy); }

.portrait { width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; background: var(--mist); }
.caption { margin-top: 12px; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--muted); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }

/* ---------- Figures ---------- */
.figures { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.fig-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.fig { padding: 40px 32px 40px 0; }
.fig + .fig { padding-left: 32px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.fig .n { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 4.6vw, 4rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1; color: var(--navy); font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; }
.fig .n sup { font-size: .45em; color: var(--accent); vertical-align: super; margin-left: 2px; }
.fig p { margin-top: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; max-width: 24ch; }

/* ---------- Sections ---------- */
section { padding: 112px 0; }
section.alt { background: var(--mist); }
.split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4fr 8fr; gap: 64px; }
.split .label { position: sticky; top: 108px; align-self: start; }
.split .label h2 { margin-top: 18px; }
.prose { display: grid; gap: 22px; max-width: 64ch; font-size: 1.06rem; }
.prose .first { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.55rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 300; }
.pull { margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 32px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--navy); }
.pull p { font-family: var(--font-display); font-style: italic; font-weight: 300; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.3; color: var(--navy); max-width: 30ch; }
.pull cite { display: block; margin-top: 18px; font-style: normal; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .04em; }

.sec-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4fr 8fr; gap: 64px; margin-bottom: 56px; align-items: end; }
.sec-head h2 { margin-top: 18px; }
.sec-head p { color: var(--muted); max-width: 56ch; }

/* Point of view */
.pov { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 48px; }
.pov article { border-top: 2px solid var(--navy); padding-top: 24px; display: grid; gap: 14px; align-content: start; }
.pov .k { font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.pov p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .98rem; }

/* Expertise list */
.svc-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--navy); }
.svc { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 80px 5fr 6fr 40px; gap: 32px; padding: 30px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); align-items: baseline; }
.svc .i { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.svc p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .98rem; }
.svc .go { color: var(--accent); justify-self: end; font-size: 1.2rem; transition: transform .2s ease; }
.svc:hover .go { transform: translateX(4px); }

/* Sectors matrix */
.matrix { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--navy); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.cell { border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 32px 28px 28px; display: grid; gap: 12px; align-content: start; background: var(--paper); transition: background .2s ease; }
.cell:hover { background: var(--mist); }
section.alt .cell:hover { background: var(--paper); }
section.alt .cell { background: var(--mist); }
.cell .i { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.cell h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; }
.cell p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.55; }
.cell .reg { margin-top: 6px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }

/* Approach timeline */
.timeline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 40px; position: relative; padding-top: 36px; }
.timeline::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--rule); }
.phase { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 12px; align-content: start; }
.phase::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -36px; left: 0; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.phase:first-child::before { background: var(--accent); }
.phase .when { font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.phase p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .96rem; }

/* Credentials */
.two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; }
.two h3 { padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy); }
.two ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.two li { padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--text); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; }
.two li::before { content: "—"; color: var(--accent); }

/* FAQ */
.faq { border-top: 1px solid var(--navy); }
.faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.faq summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; padding: 26px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.35rem; color: var(--navy); }
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.faq summary::after { content: "+"; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 300; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--accent); }
.faq details[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
.faq details p { padding: 0 0 28px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 68ch; }

/* CTA band */
.band { background: var(--band); color: var(--band-text); padding: 112px 0 96px; }
.band-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7fr 5fr; gap: 80px; align-items: end; }
.band h2 { color: var(--band-text); font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.2vw, 3.6rem); }
.band h2 em { font-style: italic; color: #6fd3ae; }
.band p { margin-top: 22px; color: var(--band-muted); max-width: 52ch; }
.band .btn { background: var(--band-text); color: #071d2e; margin-top: 36px; }
.band .btn:hover { background: #6fd3ae; }
.band .ph { color: #071d2e; background: #cfe9df; }
.contact { border-top: 1px solid var(--band-rule); }
.contact div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--band-rule); flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: .95rem; }
.contact .k { color: var(--band-muted); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding-top: 3px; }
.contact a, .contact .v { color: var(--band-text); text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.contact a:hover { color: #6fd3ae; }
footer { background: var(--band); color: var(--band-muted); font-size: .82rem; }
footer .wrap { border-top: 1px solid var(--band-rule); padding: 28px 0 36px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .nav ul { display: none; }
  .hero-grid, .band-grid, .split, .sec-head, .two { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  .hero-grid .portrait-wrap { max-width: 420px; }
  .split .label { position: static; }
  .sec-head { gap: 16px; }
  .pov { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 36px; }
  .matrix { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .timeline { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; row-gap: 64px; }
  .timeline::before { display: none; }
  .phase::before { top: -26px; }
  .svc { grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; }
  .svc p { grid-column: 2; }
  .svc .go { display: none; }
  section { padding: 80px 0; }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  body { font-size: 16px; }
  .wrap { width: calc(100% - 36px); }
  .hero { padding: 56px 0 48px; }
  .byline { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .byline .lede { grid-column: 1; grid-row: auto; margin-top: 14px; }
  .matrix, .timeline { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .fig-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .fig, .fig + .fig { padding: 28px 0; border-left: 0; }
  .fig + .fig { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
  .nav .cta-link { font-size: .82rem; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } * { transition: none !important; } }
</style>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero-grid">
    <div>
      <span class="eyebrow">Founder profile</span>
      <h1>Building practical, <em>sustainable</em> AI for the supply chains that move Canada.</h1>
      <div class="byline">
        <span class="name">J. McGrowder</span>
        <span class="title">Founder &amp; Managing Director, EMIRG Group</span>
        <p class="lede">Senior Operations Manager and supply chain consultant with more than ten years of experience, now helping everyday Canadian businesses put AI to work on the floor, on the road and at the border.</p>

<main>
<section id="perspective">
  <div class="wrap split">
    <div class="label">
      <span class="eyebrow">01 — The founder</span>
      <h2>From the warehouse floor to the boardroom</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="prose">
      <p class="first">Supply chains are won or lost in the details: a missed cut-off, a mis-slotted pallet, a reefer that runs warm overnight. I've spent my career managing those details.</p>
      <p>Over more than ten years as a Senior Operations Manager and consultant, I've run inbound and outbound flows, carrier networks, inventory programs and the teams behind them, across a range of employers, including 3PLs and startups.</p>
      <p>Along the way I saw the same gap again and again. Large enterprises were investing heavily in AI for forecasting, routing and visibility. The small and mid-sized companies that make up most of Canada's supply chain were still running on spreadsheets, phone calls and instinct, because few solutions were built for them.</p>
      <p>I founded EMIRG Group to close that gap. Business, technology and data, applied by someone who has worked the floor, and measured the way operators measure: fewer stockouts, lower cost per shipment, less waste, fewer empty kilometres.</p>
      <blockquote class="pull">
        <p>"AI shouldn't be a science project. It should make Monday morning easier for the people moving the freight."</p>
        <cite>J. McGrowder, Founder &amp; Managing Director</cite>
      </blockquote>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="alt">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div><span class="eyebrow">02 — Point of view</span><h2>What sustainable AI means to us</h2></div>
      <p>Every EMIRG Group engagement is held to three tests. A solution that fails any one of them isn't finished.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pov">
      <article><span class="k">Environmental</span><h3>Less waste and fewer empty kilometres</h3><p>Sharper forecasts reduce spoilage and overstock. Smarter routing and load building cut fuel and emissions. We report carbon impact alongside cost.</p></article>
      <article><span class="k">Financial</span><h3>AI that pays for itself</h3><p>We start with the problem that costs you most, set a baseline, and prove the return in a focused pilot before anything scales.</p></article>
      <article><span class="k">Operational</span><h3>Built for your team to own</h3><p>Solutions fit the WMS, TMS, ERP or spreadsheets you already use, and we train your people so results last after we step back.</p></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="expertise">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div><span class="eyebrow">03 — Expertise</span><h2>How EMIRG Group helps</h2></div>
      <p>Start with one capability or combine several into a roadmap. Every engagement is led personally by the founder.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="svc-list">
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">01</span><h3>AI readiness assessment</h3><p>A fixed-scope review of your data, systems and processes, ending in a prioritised list of opportunities ranked by return and effort.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">02</span><h3>Demand forecasting &amp; inventory</h3><p>Machine-learning forecasts and reorder points that reduce stockouts and release working capital.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">03</span><h3>Warehouse &amp; transportation optimisation</h3><p>Slotting, labour planning, routing and load building, with fuel and emissions tracked next to cost.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">04</span><h3>Document &amp; workflow automation</h3><p>AI that reads and enters bills of lading, invoices, purchase orders and customs paperwork.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">05</span><h3>Supply chain visibility</h3><p>One live view of orders, inventory, shipments and KPIs, with alerts before issues reach your customer.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">06</span><h3>Fractional operations leadership</h3><p>Senior operations management on a part-time basis for growing companies not yet ready for a full-time hire.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
      <div class="svc"><span class="i">07</span><h3>Training &amp; change management</h3><p>Hands-on enablement so supervisors and staff trust the tools and use them every day.</p><span class="go">→</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="sectors" class="alt">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div><span class="eyebrow">04 — Sectors</span><h2>Eight sectors, one operator's lens</h2></div>
      <p>Each sector moves goods differently and answers to different rules. These are the places AI creates value fastest in each.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="matrix">
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">01</span><h3>3PL &amp; Freight Forwarding</h3><p>Labour forecasting, dock scheduling, faster quoting and automated shipping documents.</p><span class="reg">Slotting · Quoting · Visibility</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">02</span><h3>Manufacturing</h3><p>Demand-driven production planning, raw material and MRO inventory, supplier risk alerts.</p><span class="reg">S&amp;OP · Inventory · Supplier risk</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">03</span><h3>Automotive Supply Chain</h3><p>Just-in-time and just-in-sequence support, inbound parts visibility, early shortage warnings.</p><span class="reg">JIT / JIS · Cross-border</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">04</span><h3>Cold Chain</h3><p>Excursion prediction from sensor data, shelf-life-aware rotation and reefer route planning.</p><span class="reg">2–8 °C · Frozen · IoT</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">05</span><h3>Retail &amp; E-commerce</h3><p>SKU-level forecasting, multi-location inventory balancing, returns triage, last-mile cost.</p><span class="reg">Forecasting · Fulfilment · Returns</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">06</span><h3>Food &amp; Beverage</h3><p>Waste reduction through better forecasts, lot traceability for recalls, FEFO picking.</p><span class="reg">SFCR traceability · FEFO</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">07</span><h3>Healthcare Logistics</h3><p>Critical-supply forecasting, expiry management and audit-ready chain of custody.</p><span class="reg">GDP · Serialisation · Expiry</span></article>
      <article class="cell"><span class="i">08</span><h3>Customs &amp; Trade Compliance</h3><p>AI-assisted tariff classification, invoice checks, duty and origin scenario planning.</p><span class="reg">CBSA CARM · CUSMA · HS codes</span></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="wrap split">
    <div class="label"><span class="eyebrow">07 — Questions</span><h2>Common questions</h2></div>
    <div class="faq">
      <details><summary>Do I need a data team or new software?</summary><p>No. Most clients start with the data already in their ERP, WMS, TMS or spreadsheets. We choose tools that fit your current systems and your team's skills.</p></details>
      <details><summary>Is my business too small for AI?</summary><p>EMIRG Group was built for small and mid-sized businesses. If you make decisions about inventory, labour or freight, there is almost always a practical place to start.</p></details>
      <details><summary>How quickly will I see results?</summary><p>The assessment delivers a clear roadmap within a few weeks. Most pilots aim to show measurable results within 30 to 90 days.</p></details>
      <details><summary>How is our data handled?</summary><p>Your data is used only for your project, never sold or shared, and handled in line with Canadian privacy law. We're happy to sign an NDA before any data changes hands.</p></details>
